title.narrative: Advancing Inclusive and Crisis-Responsive Education Systems in Jordan through Strengthened Policy Frameworks and Higher Education Governance

description.narrative: 1. Jordan’s education system faces sustained pressure from protracted crises, affecting equitable access to quality learning, particularly for children with disabilities and vulnerable groups. To address this, the initiative aims to strengthen system resilience and inclusivity by enhancing policy frameworks and institutional capacities for crisis-responsive education. Key actions include developing procedural guidance under the Inclusive Education Framework and strengthening coordination and capacities of relevant institutions. The initiative will result in improved policy coherence, stronger institutional readiness, and more inclusive, crisis-responsive education delivery. 2. Jordan’s higher education system is undergoing reform under the Economic Modernization Vision and ESP 2026–2030, alongside ministry merger, creating an opportunity to strengthen autonomy, accountability, and crisis management while enhancing mobility and regional collaboration. In a protracted refugee context, this aligns with UNESCO 43 C/5 Output 1.8 to improve teaching and learning in crisis settings. The objective is to strengthen policy coherence and institutional capacity for system recovery. Activities include a rapid policy review, one national dialogue with MoEHRD and university partners, and a policy brief. Deliverables include a review report, dialogue recommendations, and a policy brief.
